subtitle.en: A quick new wallpaper, to say thanks for the kind words while everyone is working hard.
subtitle.zh: 大家都在忙，于是加一张新壁纸，谢谢大家的好话。

blocks.en: We are all working hard, hence the silence on the blog. Always appreciate the kind words in the replies, so I wanted to at least add a quick new wallpaper to say thanks. Hope you like it!
blocks.zh: 我们都在努力工作，所以博客上没什么动静。回复里的那些好话我一直很感激，所以至少想赶紧添一张新壁纸表示感谢。希望你喜欢！
